title: calochortus nuttallii var. aureus
intro: Calochortus nuttallii var. aureus, commonly known as the Golden Mariposa Lily, is a perennial plant species in the Liliaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Calochortus nuttallii var. aureus include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
